name: obligations-pane
description: Side pane showing the memory-kit obligations tier (memory/obligations.yaml), soonest expiry first; read-only

agentName.title: Agent name
agentName.description: The name the footer shows for this session's main agent. Empty uses the working directory's name.

memoryDir.title: Memory directory
memoryDir.description: The kit home's memory directory, for a session that runs outside the home. Relative paths resolve against the session's working directory. Empty reads memory_dir from <cwd>/memory-kit.conf, else <cwd>/memory.

autoOpen.title: Open at session start
autoOpen.description: Open the pane when a session starts in a folder that has an obligations file (it still waits for a wide enough terminal). /obligations opens it any time.
